# Store Orders In SQLite

## Context

Orders were kept in JSON files, which were corrupted when two writes came at once (commit "feat(db): store orders in
SQLite instead of JSON files").

## Decision

Store orders in SQLite.

## Consequences

Writes no longer corrupt the store; there is one database file to back up.
